name: ameya-crm-mobile
description: Capacitor native shell (iOS + Android) that wraps the live Ameya Heights CRM PWA.

scripts.prepare:web: mkdir -p www && printf '<!doctype html><meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; url=https://crm.ameyaheights.com/dashboard">' > www/index.html
scripts.add:ios: npm run prepare:web && npx cap add ios
scripts.add:android: npm run prepare:web && npx cap add android
scripts.sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync
